OUR MISSION IS TO ENABLE EVERYONE TO BUILD WEALTH

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Тoday, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management — a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

THE ROLE

You'll own a set of features inside a product area and work with a Senior Product Manager while you learn the business. Our teams cover trading and execution (order routing, settlement, corporate actions), tax-efficient investing and pensions (ISAs, SIPPs and German pension accounts), crypto, and client accounts and payments (onboarding, client money, cards and FX). You work directly with engineers and designers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Prioritise your features with your manager, from client needs, product data and commercial goals

- Read the regulation, the API documentation and the operational process yourself, and bring a position to your Senior PM before Legal and Compliance review it

- Write the spec: client journey, business rules, data, integrations and acceptance criteria, detailed enough to build and test from

- Carry your decisions through delivery with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance and Operations, with senior support when you need it

- Take your features through testing and launch, then run them: monitoring, client feedback, the numbers, the next improvement

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

- A product or a set of features you shipped yourself and can walk through in detail, including where it broke: a rounding rule, a time zone, a rule you got wrong, an API that changed under you

- Enough technical understanding to read documentation, follow a data flow and reason about system behaviour with engineers

- Your own numbers: you query the data yourself and can explain every figure you quote

- Evidence of regular use of AI in product work, including best practices

WHAT WE OFFER:

- Real ownership from day one: your features, your spec, your launch, with a Senior Product Manager behind you

- A co-founder in your interview loop and in your work

- Challenges that will help you grow and realize your potential fast

- Opportunity to make a significant impact —you will build innovative services used by millions of investors to build wealth

- Work with smart, spirited, helpful, high-performing colleagues with a common goal

- An environment where nothing is set in stone

- Appreciation for your talent and ideas

- Generous remuneration package

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!
